declare
 dummy number;
 v_sysdate date; -- Added by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
begin
 -- Added by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 v_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate);
 else
 v_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if;
 -- End of change

 if :global.screen_mode='SUPER' then

 if :ctrl_blk.user_id is not null then
 begin
 select 1
 into dummy
 from system_users a
 where user_id = :ctrl_blk.user_id
 --and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(eff_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 and exists ( select 1
 from central_notes
 --where insert_date between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt -- Commented by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 where trunc(insert_date) between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt -- Added by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 and insert_user = a.user_id);
 exception
 
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('1253'); /* Invalid user ID */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 end if;
 else
 
 if :ctrl_blk.user_id is not null then
 if :ctrl_blk.user_id != :banner.user_id then
 show_error('1253');
 end if;
 end if;

 end if;

end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM1 (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
 alert_button number;
 al_id alert;

/*Cursor to find the count of notes entered by each user from central_notes */

cursor c1 is
 select insert_user,count(*) cnt
 from central_notes
 where insert_date between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt
 and insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk.user_id,decode(:global.screen_mode,'SUPER',insert_user,'USER',:banner.user_id))
 and program_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk.program_id,program_id)
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- Commented by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id -- Added by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 group by insert_user;

/* Cursor to find the notes enetered by each program from central_notes */

cursor c2 is
 select program_id,count(*) cnt
 from central_notes
 --where insert_date between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt -- Commented by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 where trunc(insert_date) between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt -- Added by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 and insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk.user_id,decode(:global.screen_mode,'SUPER',insert_user,'USER',:banner.user_id))
 and program_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk.program_id,program_id)
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id -- Commented by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id -- Added by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 group by program_id;


BEGIN
 -- Find total Number of notes.
 
 select count(*)
 into :ctrl_blk.total_notes
 from central_notes
 --where insert_date between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt -- Commented by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 where trunc(insert_date) between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt -- Added by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 and insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk.user_id,decode(:global.screen_mode,'SUPER',insert_user,'USER',:banner.user_id))
 and program_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk.program_id,program_id)
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id; -- Commented by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 and decode(chapter_id, 'ALL', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id; -- Added by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 
 if :ctrl_blk.total_notes=0 then
 al_id := find_alert('note_alert');
 set_alert_property(al_id,alert_message_text,'No Notes for this selection criteria');
 alert_button := show_alert(al_id);
 
 if alert_button=ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 goto END_PROCESSING;
 end if;

 end if;

 -- Populate notes block.
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 set_block_property('notes_header',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'insert_date between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt and
 insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk.user_id,decode(:global.screen_mode,''SUPER'',insert_user,''USER'',:banner.user_id)) and
 program_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk.program_id,program_id) and
 chapter_id = :global.chapter_id');
 -- End of commented section */ 
 
 /* -- Commented by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 -- Added by Kishore on 10/08/2014. IM 10173
 set_block_property('notes_header',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'insert_date between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt and
 insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk.user_id,decode(:global.screen_mode,''SUPER'',insert_user,''USER'',:banner.user_id)) and
 program_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk.program_id,program_id) and
 decode(chapter_id, ''ALL'', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id');
 -- End of change
 -- End of commented section */
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 10/24/2014. IM 10173
 set_block_property('notes_header',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'trunc(insert_date) between :ctrl_blk.from_dt and :ctrl_blk.to_dt and
 insert_user=nvl(:ctrl_blk.user_id,decode(:global.screen_mode,''SUPER'',insert_user,''USER'',:banner.user_id)) and
 program_id=nvl(:ctrl_blk.program_id,program_id) and
 decode(chapter_id, ''ALL'', :global.chapter_id, chapter_id) = :global.chapter_id');
 -- End of change
 
 --go_block('notes_header');
 execute_query; 


 -- Populate the user_blk block.

 set_block_property('user_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('user_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 
 go_block('user_blk'); 
 clear_block(no_validate); 
 for z in c1
 loop 
 :user_blk.user_id := z.insert_user;
 :user_blk.count := z.cnt; 
 next_record;
 end loop; 
 delete_record;
 first_record;

 set_block_property('program_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_block_property('program_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_TRUE);

-- Populate the program_blk block.
 
 go_block('program_blk'); 
 clear_block(no_validate);
 for z in c2
 loop 
 :program_blk.program_id := z.program_id;
 :program_blk.count := z.cnt; 
 next_record;
 end loop;
 delete_record;
 first_record;

 set_block_property('user_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('user_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);

 set_block_property('program_blk',INSERT_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_block_property('program_blk',DELETE_ALLOWED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 
 go_block('notes_header'); 

 item_change('ctrl_blk.from_dt','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.to_dt','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.user_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.pb_user','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.pb_program','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.program_id','D');
 item_change('ctrl_blk.retrieve','D');

 <<END_PROCESSING>>
 NULL;
END;

DECLARE
 l_chp_id VARCHAR2(4);
 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
